controller_6m.notes: Verified absent as a separate slot. Candidate exists=false is correct. There is no standalone Rule 10.07(1)(a) six-month clause: the Controlling Shareholders gave a single combined Rule 10.07 / 18C.13 undertaking running 12 months (recorded in controller_12m), which subsumes the first six months. The only 6-month lock-up is for Pathfinder SIIs (p130: 'Commencing on the date of this prospectus and ending on expiry of six months from the Listing Date' for Moqin Intelligent/Fortune Chuanghong), who are not controlling shareholders. Key persons also locked up 12 months (p129).
